ICS 31.220.10LITD 03New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 4/Sec 100) which is identical with IEC 61076-4-100 : 2001 ‘Connectors for electronic equipment - Part 4-100: Printed board connectors with assessed quality - Detail specification for two-part connector modules having a grid of 2.5 mm for printed boards andbackplanes’ issued by the International Electro technical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Electromechanical Components and Mechanical Structures for Electronic Equipment’s Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Information Technology Division Council.
